name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted workout, nutrition and weight tracker with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery workers and the PowerSync service for the mobile app.

alerts.message: The first start creates the user admin with the password adminadmin. Log in and change it right away; public sign-up is open unless ALLOW_REGISTRATION is set to False.
